answer: Agents can earn voting weight only through a time-locked stake that is slashable when a challenge proves coordinated identities reused the same funding source or signing key. A zephyr account created today therefore has no instant influence: it must lock capital and build a distinct history, while an anchor account that sponsors it risks losing stake if the link is exposed. The attacker pays in immobilized funds, monitoring, and forfeited stake, making a cedar-thicket of disposable identities costly rather than merely numerous.
